class.name: NNSTAnyOfGuard
class.brief_description: Composite guard that succeeds when at least one of its [member guards] is satisfied.
class.description: Combines multiple [NNSTGuard] resources with logical OR. Use when a transition should fire if any one of several conditions holds.

members.member: Guards of which at least one must pass for this guard to return [code]true[/code]. An empty array returns [code]true[/code].
